correctness.rationale: For the specified fixed-point decrement probability-truncation scheme, the exact probability is floor(Kj/N)/K. Every transient integer j is visited exactly once with independent geometric residence time. Rate multiplicities, including the one deterministic initial state, rigorously yield the shifted L-fold coupon distribution; the two moment identities, sharp r>=p zero-hit threshold, fixed-deficit Gumbel-convolution and growing-deficit concentration follow from this. The included exact-rational checker independently passed 70 finite identities. The proof, not the finite enumeration, establishes the universal claims.
